text:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 — multiple container restarts in inference-prod-us-west-2. Symptom: GPU OOM during prefill for very large contexts, streaming connections dropped. Paging @oncall-ml :rotating_light:

oncall-ml: I'm on the bridge, grabbing logs now. Joining vc 10.

alice: seeing repeated `CUDA out of memory` in container logs during prefill stage. Example:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 12.00 GiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total capacity)
  at /opt/runtime/serving/allocator.cu:452
  prefill_step() +0x3f2
```

ben: ramping hotpool by +2 nodes to give headroom, but pods still restart after prefill. Suspect long-prefix KV growth + fragmentation.

carla: CS: seeing streaming disconnects and 503 errors for three paying customers (cust-a, cust-b, cust-c). Open support tickets and initial customer msg dispatched to affected accounts.

oncall-ml: quick mitigation plan: 1) push runtime flag to cap prefill tokens `--max-prefill-tokens=65536` 2) enable fallback routing to `redwood-small` for requests > 32k tokens 3) turn on aggressive KV eviction (threshold 0.6) 4) avoid restarting running pods unless necessary. Applying hotpatch to hotpool now.

deploy-bot: Hotpatch rollout started: 4/6 pods updated (hotpatch/2026-03-17-001).

alice: after hotpatch, many prefill failures converted to graceful rejections instead of OOM, streaming drop rate down ~85%. Still seeing 1 pod with repeated OOMs — logs show large contiguous allocations from a single request (probing long system prompt).

sre-lead: will cordon that node and drain pods to failover to healthy nodes to stop noisy restarts. Also capturing `nvidia-smi -q` + dmesg for the node.

ben: collecting allocator traces and `cuda-memcheck` dumps; sending archive to /mtr/incidents/7265432100. Early signal of fragmentation in the kernel-level allocator under long contiguous prefill.

carla: updated customers: "We're seeing GPU memory failures impacting streaming for long-context requests. We've deployed a mitigation to limit large prefill requests and are routing oversized requests to a fallback model. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary."

oncall-ml: monitoring metrics: prefill OOM rate down from 0.9% -> 0.08% in 12m after changes. Streaming error count reduced similarly. Leaving enhanced KV eviction on for the next 6h.

alice: note for postmortem: reproduce with synthetic long-window load, capture KV growth over time, and validate allocator's coalescing on our GPU drivers.

oncall-ml: handing off to night oncall @dave. Handoff notes: 1) hotpatch in place (max-prefill 65k, fallback routing), 2) one noisy pod cordoned and drained, 3) logs and artifacts at /mtr/incidents/7265432100, 4) customer notifications sent. If OOMs reappear, escalate to eng-runtime.

dave: ack — taking over. I'll keep watch for 2h and will escalate if OOM > 0.2% in that window.

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> acknowledged, mitigation in place, monitoring.
